UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile with strict role separation between instructor and students.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name shown on exam submissions and dashboards.

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google Sign-In.

role.description: Access role. Non-bootstrapped users are strictly locked to student.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was first created (immutable).

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the user's most recent sign-in.

ExamAttempt.title: ExamAttempt
ExamAttempt.description: Immutable snapshot of a student's official end-of-class exam attempt with instructor review fields.

attemptId.description: Unique document ID for this attempt.

studentUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student who submitted this attempt.

studentName.description: Student display name at submission time.

studentEmail.description: Verified student email at submission time.

classTitle.description: Snapshot title of the class at submission time.

attemptNumber.description: Sequential attempt counter for this student and class (1..500).

autoGradedCorrect.description: Count of correctly answered MCQ and Multi-Select questions.

autoGradedTotal.description: Total number of auto-graded MCQ and Multi-Select questions.

answersUnlocked.description: Option A smart reveal flag: true when attemptNumber >= 3 or scorePercent >= 80.

answers.description: Bounded list (1..20) of question-level answer snapshots so future slide updates never break historical results.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last instructor review update.

reviewStatus.description: Short-answer review state. Always pending on create; instructor marks reviewed.

teacherFeedback.description: Instructor written feedback on the attempt and short-answer response.

shortAnswerScore.description: Instructor score on the short written question (0..2).

reviewedBy.description: Verified instructor email who reviewed this attempt.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores verified Google user profiles with strict PII isolation (owner or instructor read-only) and non-escalatable role.

/examAttempts/{attemptId}.description: Stores permanent student exam attempt snapshots across all classes. Students create and read only their own attempts; instructor reads all attempts and updates review feedback fields only.
